cards.card_text: Then Moses says the LORD will send curses, confusion and reproof.
cards.verse_text: The LORD will send curses upon you, confusion and reproof in all to which you put your hand, until you are destroyed and quickly perish because of the wickedness you have committed in forsaking Him.
cards.snippet: The LORD will send curses upon you, confusion and reproof in all to which you put your hand, until you are destroyed…

cards.card_text: Moses says the LORD will send curses, confusion and reproof on Israel.
cards.verse_text: The LORD will send curses upon you, confusion and reproof in all to which you put your hand, until you are destroyed and quickly perish because of the wickedness you have committed in forsaking Him.
cards.snippet: The LORD will send curses upon you, confusion and reproof in all to which you put your hand, until you are destroyed…

cards.card_text: Wisdom says they accepted none of her counsel and despised all her reproof.
cards.verse_text: They accepted none of my counsel; they despised all my reproof.
cards.snippet: They accepted none of my counsel; they despised all my reproof.

cards.card_text: Right alongside the lamp and the light, the teacher says the reproofs of discipline lead the son toward ___.
cards.verse_text: For this commandment is a lamp, this teaching is a light, and the reproofs of discipline are the way to life,
cards.snippet: …this commandment is a lamp, this teaching is a light, and the reproofs of discipline are the way to life,

cards.card_text: True or false: he says the one who ignores reproof stays on that path too.
cards.verse_text: Whoever heeds instruction is on the path to life, but he who ignores reproof goes astray.
cards.snippet: …heeds instruction is on the path to life, but he who ignores reproof goes astray.

cards.card_text: And whoever listens to life-giving reproof will dwell among the wise, which beats the years I spent dwelling in a junk drawer, trust me.
cards.verse_text: He who listens to life-giving reproof will dwell among the wise.
cards.snippet: He who listens to life-giving reproof will dwell among the wise.

cards.card_text: The proverb calls this man stiff-necked after much reproof.
cards.verse_text: A man who remains stiff-necked after much reproof will suddenly be shattered beyond recovery.
cards.snippet: A man who remains stiff-necked after much reproof will suddenly be shattered beyond recovery.

cards.card_text: True or false: God says He will execute great vengeance against the Philistines with furious reproof.
cards.verse_text: I will execute great vengeance against them with furious reproof.
cards.snippet: I will execute great vengeance against them with furious reproof.

cards.card_text: Then the LORD says, 'But let no man contend; let no man offer reproof; for your people are like those who contend with a priest.'
cards.verse_text: But let no man contend; let no man offer reproof; for your people are like those who contend with a priest.
cards.snippet: But let no man contend; let no man offer reproof; for your people are like those who contend with a priest.
